ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Culture（中世日本 - 文化）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Ancient & Medieval Japan - Culture adapts everyday social behavior and intoxicant supply to ancient and medieval Japanese play. It limits ordinary sources of anachronistic recreational and combat drugs while retaining alcohol, and modifies selected social moods, chair dining and player-designated entrance/no-shoes areas. Background and trait generation is owned by the separate optional AMJ Backgrounds & Traits Mod. Historical non-drug tea and kogashi-yu are owned by the separate optional AMJ Culture - Tea child Mod; Culture does not require either child Mod. Harmony is required; Medieval Overhaul is optional. A new game is recommended. Adding or removing Culture mid-save is untested and not recommended. Existing Def identities, held items and addictions are preserved where possible, but existing-save compatibility is not guaranteed. Development build for RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7; not all features and optional combinations are game-verified.
中世日本の生活文化と嗜好品に合わせてRimWorldの一部の挙動を変更する。時代に合わない娯楽薬・戦闘薬の通常供給を制限する一方、酒は維持する。特定の心情、イス単独での食事、プレイヤーが指定する玄関・土足禁止エリアにも対応する。人物の背景・特性は別Mod「AMJ Backgrounds & Traits（背景と特性）」が、非ドラッグの茶・こがし湯は子Mod「AMJ Culture - Tea」が担当する。いずれも任意併用で必須依存ではない。Harmony必須、Medieval Overhaul任意。新規ゲーム推奨。既存セーブへの途中導入・途中削除は未検証で推奨しない。既存の定義、所持品、依存症は可能な限り保持するが、旧セーブ互換性は保証しない。RimWorld 1.6／1.7向け開発版であり、一部機能・任意構成は実ゲーム未検証。
